outfit.name: 历世流风 · 抹胸黑礼裙与青披肩
outfit.prose: A sleek strapless black formal gown with a high side slit draped with a translucent aqua silk shawl, styled with a gold serpent cuff, layered necklaces, sheer stockings, and gold heeled sandals.

outfit.identityProseOverride: Ho'olheyak from Arknights has grey hair, aqua eyes, small feathered wings at her head and a snake tail.
